chunks: He said: Abu Bakr Muhammad ibn Umar al-Ji'abi reported from Ishaq ibn Muhammad, who reported from Zayd ibn al-Mu'addal, from Sayf ibn Umar, from Muhammad ibn Kurayb, from his father, from Abdullah ibn Abbas that the Prophet, peace be upon him and his progeny, said:
Listen and obey those whom Allah has granted the authority -- for that is the system of Islam.

key_terms.أهل البيت: People of the House -- implicitly referenced as those whom Allah grants authority
key_terms.الأمر: Authority, governance -- the divinely designated command over the affairs of Muslims
key_terms.نظام: System, order -- the fundamental organizing principle that holds the Muslim community together

ai.seo_question: What did Prophet Muhammad say about obeying those whom Allah has placed in authority?
ai.summary: In this prophetic tradition narrated through the eminent companion Abdullah ibn Abbas, the Prophet Muhammad (PBUH) commands Muslims to listen to and obey those divinely appointed to authority. He declares that such obedience constitutes the fundamental system and order of Islam, emphasizing that legitimate governance is not a matter of popular choice but of divine designation.
